texts.li: {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} over a bowl of soup that two warlords up north are burning each other's fields again. Grain will be dear by winter.
According to {X_nameDef}, a town three weeks east has the coughing sickness and they've started nailing doors shut. {A_nameDef} asked which side of the door the nails go.
{X_nameDef} says salt costs twice what it did last year, the bridge at the ford washed out, and some village elected a goat as headman. {A_nameDef} believes two of these.
{A_nameDef} spent an hour getting the news from {X_nameDef}: who's at war, who's starving, who got hanged. Mostly the same names as last time.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} about a one-eyed swordswoman down south who has never lost a duel, mostly because she only fights drunks. {A_nameDef} wants to meet her anyway.
{X_nameDef} once watched a duelist called the Heron cut a candle in half without tipping it over. {A_nameDef} spent the evening trying it with a kitchen knife and far too many candles.
{A_nameDef} made {X_nameDef} describe the famous swordsman's footwork three times, then practiced it in the yard until dark. {X_nameDef} admitted the swordsman was shorter than the story.
{X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how {FACTION} cooks stretch a stew over four days: more salt, more onion, fewer questions. {A_nameDef} paid for it with a trick for rice that doesn't stick.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} argued all afternoon about whether berries belong in a meat pie. They settled it by baking one of each and eating both.
{X_nameDef} swears by a pinch of ash in the bread. {A_nameDef} tried it, made a face, tried it again, and is now putting ash in the bread.
{A_nameDef} traded {X_nameDef} a pemmican recipe for one that makes old muffalo chewable. Each of them is sure they got the better deal.
{X_nameDef} ran a hand along a wall {A_nameDef} built and asked who laid it. {A_nameDef} said "nobody important", then stood beside it for the rest of the afternoon.
{X_nameDef} said the colony's walls were straighter than any {X_pronoun} had seen this side of the mountains. {A_nameDef} has worked this into every conversation since.
{X_nameDef} rapped a knuckle on a doorframe {A_nameDef} had hung and nodded at the sound. {A_nameDef} didn't need anything else said.
{X_nameDef} stood in front of {A_nameDef}'s carving for a long time, then asked what it was. {A_nameDef} said it was grief. {X_nameDef} said that made sense.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} what the little carving by the door would cost. It wasn't for sale. {A_nameDef} spent the whole evening pleased about being asked.
{X_nameDef} went quiet in front of {A_nameDef}'s work, wiped {X_possessive} eyes, and wouldn't say why. {A_nameDef} has decided to take it as a review.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} played raiders and colonists behind the barn until both of them were raiders and there was nobody left to raid.
{X_nameDef} taught {A_nameDef} a clapping song from the road. Half the words are rude. {A_nameDef} will be singing it for a month.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} caught a frog, named it, lost it, and held a funeral for it. They are best friends now, at least until the caravan leaves.
{A_nameDef} showed {X_nameDef} the best hiding spot in the colony. {X_nameDef} found a better one within ten minutes, which {A_nameDef} is taking hard.
{X_nameDef} sang a long song by the fire about a miller's daughter and a bear. By the end, {A_nameDef} wasn't sure whose side to be on, and neither was the song.
{X_nameDef} told ghost stories by the fire until {A_nameDef} jumped at a settling log. {X_nameDef} called it the best reaction yet and told another one.
{X_nameDef} knew a drinking song with forty verses. {A_nameDef} had the chorus by the fifth and was bellowing it by the twentieth.
By the fire, {X_nameDef} told how {X_possessive} caravan once crossed a frozen lake and lost two muffalo to the ice. {A_nameDef} hung on every crack.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} {A_pronoun} had kind eyes for someone carrying that many knives. {A_nameDef} has been checking {A_possessive} reflection in the water barrel ever since.
{A_nameDef} offered to show {X_nameDef} the view from the wall. There isn't much of a view from the wall. They were up there for an hour.
{X_nameDef} laughed at every one of {A_nameDef}'s jokes, including the one about the boomalope. Nobody laughs at the one about the boomalope.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} shared a bench, a jug of beer and very little elbow room. The caravan leaves tomorrow, which might be the point.
{X_nameDef} called the colony "a mud fort with opinions". {A_nameDef} offered to show {X_objective} the opinions up close, and had to be walked away from the gate.
{X_nameDef} said a settlement this small ought to pay {FACTION} for protection. {A_nameDef} said a great many things back, several of them about {X_nameDef}'s mother.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} argued about how to treat strangers: loudly, at the gate, in front of other strangers. Nobody came out of it looking good.
{X_nameDef} squinted at {A_nameDef} and asked, "You're that one, aren't you? From the stories?" {A_nameDef} has no idea which stories, and isn't going to ask.
{X_nameDef} said people on the road talk about {A_nameDef}, and not all of it is lies. {A_nameDef} spent dinner trying to find out which parts.
{X_nameDef} asked to touch {A_nameDef}'s sleeve for luck. {A_nameDef} allowed it, baffled. Apparently there's a song, and {A_nameDef} is in the second verse.
{A_nameDef} carried water for {X_nameDef}'s lame pack animal without being asked. Later, {X_nameDef} pressed some coins and a sprig of healroot into {A_possessive} hand and wouldn't take them back.
{X_nameDef} remembered that {A_nameDef} had given up a seat by the fire for {X_objective}. A little bundle was waiting for {A_nameDef} afterwards: silver and a twist of healing herbs.
{A_nameDef} mended a torn strap on {X_nameDef}'s pack. {X_nameDef} paid in silver, healroot, and a lecture about how nobody does anything for free anymore.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} compared scars by the fire. {X_nameDef} won with an arrowhead still lodged in {X_possessive} shoulder, and let {A_nameDef} feel it.
{X_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} how {FACTION} spearmen brace for a charge. {A_nameDef} showed {X_nameDef} where to hit someone who's bracing like that.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} didn't say much about the fighting itself. They named the people they'd lost, drank to each one, and that was enough.
{X_nameDef} has fought in three border wars and {A_nameDef} has fought everything that came over our wall. They talked tactics until the fire was ash.
{X_nameDef} has stared at {A_nameDef} all day: from the gate, from the well, across dinner. Asked about it, {X_nameDef} said "what?" {A_nameDef} is sleeping with a knife tonight.
{X_nameDef} watched {A_nameDef} chop wood for an hour without a word, then spat and walked off. {A_nameDef} has been going over every swing since.
Wherever {A_nameDef} went today, {X_nameDef} was leaning on something nearby, watching. Turns out {A_nameDef} looks exactly like {X_possessive} dead brother. That did not help.

{X_nameDef}'s dog followed {A_nameDef} around all afternoon and leaned on {A_possessive} legs whenever {A_pronoun} stopped. {X_nameDef} said it only does that with good people. {A_nameDef} chose to believe it.
{X_nameDef}'s scruffy dog stole a sausage off {A_nameDef}'s plate and ate it while looking {A_objective} in the eye. {A_nameDef} forgave it at once.
{A_nameDef} spent an hour picking burrs out of {X_nameDef}'s dog. {X_nameDef} admitted the dog has a stupid name. It's called Captain.
{X_nameDef} taught {A_nameDef} a dice game called Muffalo Knees and won every round. {A_nameDef} is fairly sure the rules changed twice.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} played knucklebones for pebbles all evening. {A_nameDef} won forty pebbles and has no idea what to do with them.
{X_nameDef} lost three rounds of dice to {A_nameDef}, then blamed the dice. {A_nameDef} offered {X_objective} {X_possessive} own dice. {A_nameDef} won with those too.
{A_nameDef} talked {X_nameDef} down on a bolt of cloth until the trader threw up {X_possessive} hands and called {A_objective} a bandit. {A_nameDef} took it as a compliment.
{A_nameDef} pointed out a moth hole, a crooked seam and the trader's own sad face. {X_nameDef} knocked a third off the price just to make it stop.
{X_nameDef} opened at forty silver. {A_nameDef} opened by laughing. They settled at twenty-two, and {X_nameDef} counted the coins twice in disbelief.
{A_nameDef} haggled {X_nameDef} down from twenty silver to eighteen and walked off proud. Then {A_nameDef} watched someone else buy the same thing for nine.
{X_nameDef} sold {A_nameDef} a lucky pan, a lucky rope and a lucky rock. {A_nameDef} went back later for the matching lucky rock.
{A_nameDef} tried the old trick of walking away from the deal. {X_nameDef} let {A_objective} walk. {A_nameDef} came back four minutes later and paid full price.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} about a coast where the sea stays warm in winter and fish jump into the boats. {A_nameDef} has been staring at the horizon ever since.
{X_nameDef} has seen a city with walls taller than trees and a market that never closes. {A_nameDef} asked how far. {X_nameDef} said "far" and left it there.
{X_nameDef} described salt flats white as bone, under skies so clear you can count every star. {A_nameDef} tried counting the ones over the colony that night. It wasn't the same.
{A_nameDef} bought a cask of beer from {X_nameDef}. It was half river water. {X_nameDef} was very sorry about it, and also suddenly very busy elsewhere.
{X_nameDef}'s scales were off by a thumb's weight, and {A_nameDef} noticed too late. That's three days of hauling {A_nameDef} will never see again.
The tough leather boots {A_nameDef} bought from {X_nameDef} came apart at the first puddle. {X_nameDef} explained that they were dry-weather boots.
{X_nameDef} turned a knife over in {X_possessive} hands and asked if {A_nameDef} made it. {X_nameDef} sold one just like it last year, to a captain who wouldn't stop bragging about it.
{X_nameDef} recognized {A_nameDef}'s stitching on a colonist's coat and said coats like that fetch a fortune two towns over. {A_nameDef} is pricing everything in {A_possessive} head now.
{X_nameDef} asked who made the colony's tools. When {A_nameDef} said it was {A_objective}, {X_nameDef} asked if {A_pronoun} had ever thought of leaving. {A_nameDef} said no, slowly.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} about a settlement east of here that tried to tame a thrumbo with a rope and a song. They're rebuilding, slowly.
{X_nameDef} has been to every settlement within a week's ride and has gossip on all of them: who's broke, who's feuding, and who ate their trader.
According to {X_nameDef}, the last colony {X_pronoun} visited paid in turnips and insults. {A_nameDef} took the hint and was very polite all afternoon.
{X_nameDef} let {A_nameDef} try a pinch of the spice {X_pronoun} was selling. {A_nameDef} has been trying to describe the taste to everyone, and failing.
{X_nameDef} cut {A_nameDef} a sliver of hard cheese from three weeks south. {A_nameDef} chewed it very slowly, as if it might be the last cheese in the world.
{X_nameDef} poured {A_nameDef} a thimble of something amber from a stoppered flask. {A_nameDef} coughed, wept, and asked for another thimble.
{A_nameDef} held up {X_nameDef}'s best cloak and asked how much {X_nameDef} would pay {A_objective} to take it away. The trader did not find this funny.
{A_nameDef} sniffed {X_nameDef}'s dried meat and announced that the animal had died of old age. {X_nameDef} has stopped offering {A_nameDef} anything.
{A_nameDef} told {X_nameDef} that {FACTION} prices are the reason the roads have bandits: the bandits are just trying to afford things.
{X_nameDef} sent {A_nameDef} back to the kitchen twice: once because the soup was cold, once because it was too hot. Then {X_nameDef} tipped {A_objective} eight silver, which was somehow worse.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} where the bath was. {A_nameDef} pointed at the river. {X_nameDef} has not stopped talking about it.
{X_nameDef} had {A_nameDef} turn the mattress three times, then complained about the view from the bed. The bed faces a wall.
{X_nameDef} called {A_nameDef} "you there" all day, and once "the hairy one". {A_nameDef} is not especially hairy, and is now worried about it.
{X_nameDef} watched {A_nameDef} settle a quarrel at dinner and said it was better done than in half the courts {X_pronoun} had sat in. Then {X_nameDef} taught {A_objective} to bow properly, unasked.
{X_nameDef} spent an evening teaching {A_nameDef} which fork is for what at a lord's table. The colony owns one kind of fork. {A_nameDef} paid close attention anyway.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} {A_pronoun} had the bearing of someone born to a better house, and that it was a shame about the clothes.
{X_nameDef} hadn't said ten words since arriving. Today {A_nameDef} brought {X_objective} a second bowl of stew without asking, and {X_nameDef} cried into it and said thank you, over and over.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} it was the first night in a month {X_pronoun} hadn't slept with {X_possessive} shoes on. {A_nameDef} didn't know what to say, and just nodded.
{X_nameDef} carved {A_nameDef} a small wooden bird with a borrowed knife, badly, and handed it over with both hands. "For the blanket," {X_nameDef} said.
{X_nameDef} got bored of being protected and felled a dead tree out back before {A_nameDef} noticed. "Beats sitting around waiting to be murdered," {X_nameDef} said.
{X_nameDef} insisted on helping {A_nameDef} cut and haul logs, did it wrong, was told, and then did it wrong more carefully. The logs got there.
{A_nameDef} came back to find that {X_nameDef} had chopped a fallen trunk into neat logs and stacked them by size. Nobody asked. It looks very nice.
{X_nameDef} woke {A_nameDef} at midnight to ask whether the gate was barred. It was. {X_nameDef} went to check anyway, and {A_nameDef} went too.
{X_nameDef} sat up all night facing the door with a kitchen knife in {X_possessive} lap. {A_nameDef} sat up too, because somebody should.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, very quietly, what the people hunting {X_objective} do to anyone who helps. Then {X_nameDef} thanked {A_objective} for the bed.
{A_nameDef} sat outside {X_nameDef}'s cell after dinner and talked about nothing: the weather, the beans, a dog {A_pronoun} once had. {X_nameDef} talked back, for the first time.
{A_nameDef} slid an extra blanket under {X_nameDef}'s door and said goodnight. {X_nameDef} didn't answer, but the blanket was gone by morning.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} why {A_pronoun} bothered being nice to a prisoner. {A_nameDef} said somebody has to be, and it might as well be {A_objective}.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} through the bars that {X_possessive} friends know where the wall is thin. {A_nameDef} went and checked the wall. Then checked it again.
{X_nameDef} spent the whole meal describing how {X_pronoun} would have burned the colony down, building by building. {A_nameDef} left half {A_possessive} dinner.
Every time {A_nameDef} walked past the cell, {X_nameDef} counted out loud. Nobody knows what {X_nameDef} is counting toward. {A_nameDef} has started taking the long way round.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} how {X_pronoun} ended up raiding: a burned farm, a debt, a cousin with a plan. {A_nameDef} came away less sure who the bad one was.
{X_nameDef} has a daughter somewhere south who thinks {X_nameDef} is a trader. {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} not to tell her, if she ever came by. {A_nameDef} promised.
Through the door, {X_nameDef} described the last meal {X_pronoun} ate at home, down to the burnt crust. {A_nameDef} stayed to listen long after the bowl was collected.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} worked out they grew up two valleys apart, on the same bad bread and the same tax collectors. They talked through the bars until the candle died.
{X_nameDef} hummed a work song in the cell, and {A_nameDef} sang the next line without thinking. Same mines, different years. Neither said much after that.
{A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} both ran away from home at twelve, both slept in stables, both stole from the same kind of people. Only one of them ended up behind this door.

ColonyCouncil.EncounterDef.label: face to face through the bars

texts.li: {A_nameDef} stood at {X_nameDef}'s door for a long time without a word. {X_nameDef} looked up, recognized {A_objective}, and looked away first.
{X_nameDef} grinned at {A_nameDef} through the bars and asked how the scar was coming along. {A_nameDef} walked away before {A_possessive} hands could decide anything.
{A_nameDef} carried {X_nameDef}'s dinner in personally, set it down, and said, "Now I know where you sleep, too."
The last time they met, {A_nameDef} was on the ground and {X_nameDef} was standing over {A_objective}. Today {X_nameDef} is on a cell floor, and {A_nameDef} can't stop looking.
{X_nameDef} sent {A_nameDef}'s stew back with a message: the rats in here eat better. The bowl had been licked clean.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that the food was the worst part of being captured, worse than the arrow. {A_nameDef} has taken this personally and keeps thinking about the arrow.
Through a full mouth, {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} whether {A_pronoun} had ever cooked before or was just guessing. Then {X_nameDef} asked for seconds.
{X_nameDef} offered {A_nameDef} a map to a buried chest of silver in exchange for one unlocked door. {X_nameDef} drew the map on the floor, in porridge.
{X_nameDef} whispered to {A_nameDef} that {X_possessive} people pay well for friends on the inside. {A_nameDef} asked how well. {X_nameDef} named a number that doesn't exist.
{X_nameDef} promised {A_nameDef} a horse, a sword and a cousin's hand in marriage for the key. {A_nameDef} said {A_pronoun} would think about the horse.
{X_nameDef} caught {A_nameDef}'s ankle from the dirt and begged, over and over, not to be left out there for the wolves.
Bleeding in the mud, {X_nameDef} recognized {A_nameDef} from a trade two seasons back and begged on the strength of it. {A_nameDef} remembered the trade. It hadn't been a good deal.
{X_nameDef} promised {A_nameDef} silver, a horse, never coming back, anything at all. The voice kept going long after {A_nameDef} was out of earshot.
{X_nameDef} couldn't stand, but could still talk, and spent all of it on {A_nameDef}: {A_possessive} mother, {A_possessive} face and {A_possessive} colony, in that order.
{X_nameDef} spat blood at {A_nameDef}'s boots and swore {X_possessive} brothers would come for {A_objective}. {A_nameDef} asked how many brothers. It was a lot of brothers.
{X_nameDef} lay in the mud cursing {A_nameDef} in a language {A_nameDef} didn't know. The tone translated fine.
{X_nameDef} asked for water, just that. {A_nameDef} knelt and held the waterskin while {X_nameDef} drank, and neither of them mentioned the fight.
{A_nameDef} gave {X_nameDef} a drink and wiped the dirt off {X_possessive} face. {X_nameDef} said nobody had done that since {X_pronoun} was small.
{X_nameDef} was trying to lick rainwater off a stone. {A_nameDef} swore under {A_possessive} breath and went to fetch a cup.
{X_nameDef} lay on {X_possessive} back praying, the same short line over and over, until {A_nameDef} realized {A_pronoun} had learned the words.
{X_nameDef} was praying to something with a great many teeth, by the sound of it. {A_nameDef} hurried past and felt watched for the rest of the day.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} to pray with {X_objective}. {A_nameDef} didn't know the god or the words, but knelt in the mud for a minute anyway.
{X_nameDef} grabbed {A_nameDef}'s sleeve and made {A_objective} repeat a name twice: Tamsin, at the mill by the black river. Tell her it wasn't her fault.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} where {X_pronoun} had buried {X_possessive} mother's knife, so that somebody would know. {A_nameDef} knows now, and wishes {A_pronoun} didn't.
Between gasps, {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} to tell the others {X_pronoun} hadn't run. {A_nameDef} promised. Nobody on our side has any idea who the others are.
{A_nameDef} stopped over the downed {X_nameDef}, spat in the dirt an inch from {X_possessive} face, and walked off whistling.
{A_nameDef} crouched by {X_nameDef} and explained, in some detail, how the fight could have gone even worse for {X_objective}. Then {A_nameDef} spat, smiled, and left.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} for help. {A_nameDef} spat on {X_objective} and said that was all the help on offer today. A few people saw.
{X_nameDef} was sure this was the end and gave {A_nameDef} a long, trembling speech about {X_possessive} regrets. It was a sprained ankle. Both of them are embarrassed.
{X_nameDef} forgave {A_nameDef}, forgave the world, and asked {A_objective} to sing {X_objective} out. {A_nameDef} pointed out the wound was mostly bruise. {X_nameDef} asked for the song anyway.
{X_nameDef} said goodbye to {A_nameDef}, to the sky, and to someone called Bram. Then {X_nameDef} fell asleep and snored, very much alive.
